source_text: Moraliter: Aegyptus in nobis, Pharao princeps vitiorum. Plagae — correptiones Dei — induratum cor emolliunt si recipimus, indurant si resistimus. Primogenita exstinguenda: initia peccati. Ut populus exeat, cor non induremus. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Morally: Egypt in us, Pharaoh prince of-vices. Plagues — corrections of-God — hardened heart soften if we-receive, harden if we-resist. Firstborn to-be-extinguished: beginnings of-sin. That people may-exit, heart not let-us-harden. Amen.
pass_b_english: Morally Egypt is in us, and Pharaoh the princely power of vice. The plagues are God’s corrections: they soften a receiving heart and harden a resisting one. The [[firstborn >> Bible:Exodus 12:29]] to be put to death are sin’s first movements. Let us not harden our hearts, that the people within may go free. Amen.
